isabel-zimmermann.cred: Registered Dietitian · MS Nutrition Sciences · sports nutrition
isabel-zimmermann.bio: Sports nutrition dietitian with nearly a decade of experience, most recently the primary sports dietitian at the University of Mississippi. A former Division I cross country and track athlete at NC State.

kristina-bauer.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · MS · pediatric weight management
kristina-bauer.bio: Registered dietitian specializing in pediatric weight management at Cincinnati Children's. Works from Health at Every Size and intuitive eating rather than restrictive dieting.

brooke-caplinger.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · Certified Personal Trainer
brooke-caplinger.bio: Registered dietitian and personal trainer of six years who pairs nutrition coaching with exercise guidance. Works in K-12 school nutrition and provides insurance-covered coaching through Kickoff.

nickie-patel.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · metabolic & hormone health
nickie-patel.bio: Registered dietitian with a kinesiology background who focuses on weight loss that protects metabolism, hormone concerns such as PCOS and thyroid, and performance goals. Uses wearable data and bloodwork to guide plans.

emily-levin.bio: Registered dietitian and Public Health Advisor in the NIH Office of Nutrition Research. Brings a public-health lens to translating nutrition evidence into everyday practice.

ashley-art.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · MS · community & clinical
ashley-art.bio: Registered dietitian at Lutheran Social Services of Central Ohio supporting community and clinical nutrition. Trained across WIC and rural healthcare settings, with a focus on guidance that fits real life.

michelle-wolff.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · CDN · relationship with food
michelle-wolff.bio: Board-certified dietitian in New York City who helps clients rebuild trust with their bodies and their relationship with food. A former Division I cross country and track athlete, with continued training in functional nutrition.

jessica-weissman.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · PhD · Certified Personal Trainer
jessica-weissman.bio: Registered dietitian, personal trainer, and Department Chair of Integrative and Functional Nutrition at Saybrook University. More than a decade across bariatric, outpatient, hospital, and wellness settings.

christopher-peterson.cred: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist · MS Nutrition Diagnostics · performance
christopher-peterson.bio: Registered dietitian specializing in clinical and performance nutrition, previously a nutrition associate with the Detroit Tigers organization. Works on sports nutrition, weight management, and hormone-driven health.

nilufer-ece-bozkan.bio: Runs Wellness with Nilufer, a remote one-on-one coaching practice built around sustainable habits and personalized wellness plans. Takes a whole-body approach across mental, physical, and everyday routines.

michaela-gleed.cred: NASM Certified Personal Trainer · Pilates · Yoga Alliance
michaela-gleed.bio: Founder and lead instructor of Habitual, blending the breath work of yoga, the control of Pilates, and the discipline of interval training into routines people keep.

jerome-bacon-iii.cred: ACSM Certified Exercise Physiologist · Corrective Exercise Specialist
jerome-bacon-iii.bio: Clinical exercise physiologist with more than two decades in cardiopulmonary rehabilitation. Builds ACSM-guided exercise prescriptions from medical records and teaches safe, self-monitored home training.

libby-thompson.bio: Exercise physiologist who began in cardiology before spending three years in an obesity management clinic at Cincinnati Children's, helping patients and families build healthier routines.

taylor-duckett.cred: NASM Certified Strength Coach · Personal Trainer
taylor-duckett.bio: Personal trainer and strength coach who has worked with hundreds of clients across every age and fitness level since 2015, and now coaches online as well as in person.

katie-callo.cred: ISSA Certified Personal Trainer · Pilates · Guinness World Record holder
katie-callo.bio: Certified personal trainer and Pilates instructor with UCLA Recreation's FITWELL program, and a Guinness World Record holder for the heaviest female hip thrust. Also a certified Diabetes Prevention Program coach.

michael-hawkins.bio: Certified strength coach with more than 25 years of dual experience in business and fitness, coaching people who have to fit training around a demanding schedule.

aaron-snyder.cred: Doctor of Physical Therapy · Orthopedic Clinical Specialist (OCS)
aaron-snyder.states: Advisor · does not see members directly
aaron-snyder.bio: Orthopedic physical therapist and Head of Basketball Performance at Agile Physical Therapy, and a former professional point guard. Advises on physical therapy.

eric-lee.cred: Doctor of Physical Therapy · CSCS · Certified Dry Needling
eric-lee.states: Advisor · does not see members directly
eric-lee.bio: Doctor of physical therapy and strength and conditioning specialist who founded ELee Performance PT in Miami, with experience across NCAA, MLB, and NFL athletes. Advises on sports performance and rehab.

hannah-todd.cred: Doctor of Physical Therapy · Pelvic Health
hannah-todd.states: Advisor · does not see members directly
hannah-todd.bio: Doctor of physical therapy and founder of Vital Core Physical Therapy, treating pelvic floor dysfunction through in-person, virtual, and hybrid care. Advises on pelvic and postpartum health.

dena-kranzberg.cred: Women's Health Nurse Practitioner (WHNP-BC) · NASM CPT · IFBB Pro
dena-kranzberg.states: Advisor · does not see members directly
dena-kranzberg.bio: Board-certified women's health nurse practitioner working in precision medicine and healthy longevity, with prior practice in perimenopause and menopause care. Advises on clinical nursing and women's health.

grace-berger.cred: Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) · CBT · DBT · ACT
grace-berger.states: Advisor · does not see members directly
grace-berger.bio: Licensed clinical social worker in Chicago providing outpatient psychotherapy for children, adolescents, and adults using CBT, DBT, and ACT. Advises on behavioral health.

kiahlei-yaste.cred: Clinical Social Worker (SWC) · Mental Health Therapist
kiahlei-yaste.states: Advisor · does not see members directly
kiahlei-yaste.bio: Clinical social worker and mental health therapist in acute behavioral health, trained in motivational interviewing and trauma-informed care. Advises on therapy and behavioral health.

spencer-tate.cred: Co-Founder, CEO · exercise coach · D1 runner · 2:28 marathon
spencer-tate.bio: Division I cross country and track at Furman, coached by national champions. A 2:28 marathoner who has coached athletes from beginner to advanced.

nemath-ahmed.bio: Former lead wellness developer at Georgia Tech with an MS in computer science focused on AI. Spent two years at Emory Hospital researching women's preventive health.

jason-calacanis.bio: Serial entrepreneur, early Uber investor, host of This Week in Startups and co-host of the All-In Podcast. Founder & CEO of LAUNCH.
